exposure: plasma viral loads greater than 400 copies/mL near delivery
less than 11 weeks of antiretroviral therapy during pregnancy
poor to moderate adherence to antiretroviral therapy
elective cesarean delivery for HIV prevention
cohort: 1,857 liveborn neonates born to HIV-infected women enrolled in the U.S. International Maternal Pediatric Adolescent AIDS Clinical Trials prospective cohort study (protocol P1025) between 2002 and 2009
finding: Despite access to high-level care, a small proportion of HIV-infected women transmitted the virus to their neonates, highlighting the need for continued efforts to prevent mother-to-child transmission of HIV.
mod_finding: Five women delivered by cesarean; four were nonelective cesarean deliveries and only one was an elective cesarean delivery for HIV prevention.
